DevBot: starting microbake canary for service=kf-infer rollout=5% region=us-east-1 change-window=2026-03-20T23:00Z-2026-03-21T01:00Z. Release: v2.14.3 -> sha256:aa1b... Deploy id: #deploy-9812.
Sam R.: tagging for visibility. is this pinned to a fallback variant?
Priya K.: no pin. fallback set to v2.14.1 in config though.
Jordan L.: telemetry dashboards warmed? any custom eval prompts running?
Ops Oncall: observability hooks are live, log retention set to 48h for this batch. I'll monitor error-rate and tail latency.
Sam R.: ok. quick checklist: migrations? schema changes? sticky KV cache?
Priya K.: no DB migrations. KV-cache key format unchanged. quantization profile is q4_0, validated on staging.
DevBot: traffic shift: initial 5% -> plan to step to 15% after 10m if no alerts. Automatic rollback thresholds: error_rate>1.2x OR p99 latency +35% -> auto pause + notify.
Jordan L.: can we enable a soft-attenuation to avoid microburst on edge? add a ramp: 5% -> 8% -> 12% -> 15% with 3m waits.
Sam R.: agree. make ramp explicit. Priya, ok on canary prompts? any known eval regressions?
Priya K.: ran quick eval set, no degradation. small hallucination uptick on one prompt group but below alert threshold. I'll keep watch.
Ops Oncall: i'll run the following watchlist: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, embed failure rate, cpu GPU mem ondedicated nodes.
Sam R.: posting rollout command w/ ramp change.
Sam R.: ```
/deploy service=kf-infer version=v2.14.3 rollout=5,8,12,15 step_delay=180s change_window=2026-03-20T23:00Z-2026-03-21T01:00Z fallback=v2.14.1
```
DevBot: acknowledge deploy command #deploy-9812-ramp-updated. Starting at 5% now. ETA to first step ~30s.
(ops-bot): reaction :rocket: on deploy.
Priya K.: watching evals and logs. will flag if hallucination group crosses 0.6 -> open issue.
Jordan L.: hooking a temporary canary tracer to sample 0.2% of requests for extra payload inspection.
Sam R.: thumbs: if anyone wants to hold, speak up now. ops-oncall?
Ops Oncall: holding thumbs. If we see auth error spike or retry flood we pause.
DevBot: telemetry snapshot at start: cpu=18% gpu=9% p99=120ms err=0.08%. Next step scheduled in 3m.
(1m later) Priya K.: seeing slight bump in p95 for a specific route /v1/chat/generate - +22% but p99 stable. not triggering auto thresholds.
Jordan L.: I can patch tracer to skip that route and sample more other routes. doing it now.
Sam R.: decision call in 90s after next metric. tentative go if stable.
(3m later) DevBot: step change to 8% applied. telemetry: p95 back to +10%, p99 +3%, errors unchanged.
Sam R.: ok moving forward to 12% after 3m delay. Priya, anything to escalate?
Priya K.: still watching hallucination group, no alert yet.
(3m later) DevBot: step change to 12% applied. telemetry: p99 +40% on a single backend shard -> Ops Oncall investigating.
Ops Oncall: saw a GC spike on node-gpu-14, restarting container to reclaim memory. suggestion: pause ramp until shard stabilizes.
Sam R.: pause. initiating manual hold. everyone acknowledge.
Priya K.: acknowledged, rolling back to 8% traffic.
DevBot: executing rollback to 8% as requested. deploy id #deploy-9812-rollback-step.
Jordan L.: I'll keep tracer active and gather sampled payloads for root cause.
Sam R.: postmortem notes: hold reason: shard-specific p99 spike related to GC after q4_0 kernel path. next steps: repro on staging, consider kernel fallback for that shard, and schedule a targeted patch.
Ops Oncall: monitoring pod restarts, will report when node stable.
Priya K.: I'm opening an issue with eval traces so we can correlate hallucination uptick across steps.
Sam R.: thanks all. closing this thread for the manual hold. We'll reconvene if Ops gives green or if auto rollback triggers. :white_check_mark:
